target_product.review_text:
This comes in an outer product box. There’s a small opening on the bottom where you can see the color of liner. The box has a cute design. The ingredients are listed on the back. It’s made in China.

The tube is actually pretty big for a glitter liner like this. Most other glitter liners like this that I have are in tubes about half the size of this one. This one is about the same size as a tube of lip gloss or concealer. So, that is nice!

I got the color “Area 51,” which is a green color. The green is really pretty.

The applicator is a thin brush tip. I show swatches. The first line on the top I had the brush laying down some, using more of the side. With that line you can see the glitter wasn’t quite as even. It definitely started having less glitter and the glitter not being spread as evenly the longer the line went on. The next line I dipped back into the tube and then applied the line using the tip of the brush at a slight angle and going very slowly. With that line I got a lot more glitter and it was a lot more even. The next line I dipped back into the tube, then I kind of dotted along the line - instead of just swiping the brush down in 1 swipe, I dotted the brush to make the line. That also worked really well. The next line I dipped back into the tube, then I had the brush practically laying flat on its side and just kind of pressed the brush onto the area. That worked well, but I did have to work it a little by pushing up and down. The final line I dipped back into the pan, drew a line using the tip of the brush at a slight angle and went very slowly, and let it dry. Then, I dipped the brush back in and drew over it again the same way. I wanted to see how well it would layer. It layered really well!

It dries pretty quickly, but the thicker the line is, the longer it takes to dry down. Once it dries, the glitter stays in place. I didn’t notice it falling off onto my face throughout the day.

Overall, I think this is a great liquid glitter liner. The color is beautiful. I’m able to apply it using the brush different ways and still get a good amount of glitter that is spread evenly. It layers well. It dries down and stays well. To me, $14.99 (at the time of writing this review) is a lot for a liquid glitter liner. But, the tube is bigger than most liquid glitter liners I have, so looking at it that way I don’t think it’s as expensive as I originally thought before I’d seen how big the tube is. The color is beautiful and it applies and wears well, so given that along with the size of the tube, I definitely would purchase this and do recommend it.

target_product.review_text:
Once I knew how to apply this everything else was easy. To apply, pull out the brush from the top of the cap, flip it around, and secure the other end of the brush inside the hole you pulled it out of. This snaps the brush in place and provides a thicker and longer brush handle with which to work. Once the brush is in place, unscrew the cap and use the brush end to apply. Reverse the procedure to secure the brush back in the cap.

I used this to highlight my upper eyelid. It glided on smoothly. However, to me this is a cream eyeliner and not a powder. The application faded a little bit around the corners of my eyes by the end of the day but for the most part it was still visible. The color is a beautiful iridescent chocolate. It also washed off easy with soap and water.

At the current cost of $24, I feel it is competitively priced. The only issue I had with this is that there are no visible instructions. There is a QR code in the flap of the box but when using my QR reader, it just sent me to senior citizen coupons. I then went to their website and searched for the full instructions which I attached in the comments section of this review. In fact, until I saw the video, I didn't realize I could snap the brush in the cap. During my first application, I used the brush separately and that was not easy since I had to pinch my fingers like a pair of tweezers.

I also feel the need to wash my hands afterwards because of the oiliness. It is lightly scented. In fact, when sniffing it right out of the bottle, I can hardly detect anything. But a few hours later, when in bed, I caught a lovely floral scent where it had been applied. I like it, but I don't love it.

I'm always interested in trying new skincare brands, products, and innovations. Though I am new to the Enature brand, I've had very good experience with South Korean skincare products. This pack has both a cleansing balm and a sleeping mask. The cleansing balm is very rich - a little bit when worked into the skin removes dirt, impurities, etc and leaves the skin feeling soft. I wipe it off with a tissue and rinse off the remainder. It can be used on its own or as the first step in a double cleanse. The sleeping mask is lighter but provides deep hydration.

I have sensitive combination skin so it is often hard to find products that are effective but gentle on my skin. These caused no redness, sensitivity, or irritation.
